purpose: Standalone bilingual current-product-state classification; not search ranking or TypeSafeJev replacement
hypothesis: Zero-shot schema-conditioned model may handle negation/current-vs-old/target-vs-other context better than simple lexical baselines
data: 48 hand-authored train rows (24 bilingual pairs), 48 test rows (24 different bilingual pairs), 4 balanced classes
comparators: char 2-5 TF-IDF plus logistic regression trained on 48 rows
metrics: raw-score-0.8 review gate coverage and errors
adoption_gate: Exploratory only. Even if model beats both baselines on Japanese, require independent real-page gold and calibration before integration. No test-tuned schema or thresholds.
limit: One checkpoint, two repeats, two CPU threads, no tuning, no GPU, no private data, no external inference API
